inspection_summary: Inspected all 1,823 normalized logical lines. Usable mathematics runs from the introduction through the rapid-growth/heterotic discussion; page furniture, graph-coordinate extraction, acknowledgments, and references were separately dispositioned. The source supports the Rankin-Selberg-Zagier pipeline, string-spectrum consequences, counterexamples and scope boundaries, concrete checks, and a clearly conjectural extension. Selected formula-bearing mechanisms are recoverable from checked prose, though exact constants and exponents retain text-layer risk.

accepted_units.title: Modular invariance turns vacuum amplitudes into spectral constraints
accepted_units.why_material: Explains why torus modularity and tachyon absence organize the infinite graded spectrum rather than permitting arbitrary Fermi-Bose imbalance.
accepted_units.context_note: Bridges stability, asymptotic supersymmetry, and misaligned alternation before the zeta claim.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose definitions of modular integration, GSO projection, and graded counting.

accepted_units.unit_type: main claim linking stability and zeta zeros
accepted_units.title: Stable tachyon-free spectra inherit zeta-zero oscillations
accepted_units.why_material: States the central bridge from Rankin-Selberg-Zagier equidistribution to an alternating high-mass spectrum and RH-controlled convergence.
accepted_units.context_note: Carried v1 span unchanged; the solid claim excludes unphysical tachyons.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Critical-line notation is formula-sensitive but resolved by surrounding prose.

accepted_units.title: Orientifold stability need not imply asymptotic supersymmetry
accepted_units.why_material: Shows stability can come from cancellation between amplitudes rather than graded fermionic states, while loss of modular symmetry blocks the method.
accepted_units.context_note: Negative control against overgeneralizing the main implication.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose distinction between oriented torus and Klein-bottle amplitudes.

accepted_units.title: Higher-genus equidistribution as an interaction-level extension
accepted_units.why_material: Records the proposed extension to Sp(2g,Z) amplitudes and string interactions.
accepted_units.context_note: Research direction only, not a derived result.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Named higher-genus modular group; no derivation.

accepted_units.title: Unfolding identifies a constant-term Mellin transform
accepted_units.why_material: Modular invariance unfolds the Eisenstein inner product into the Mellin transform of the Fourier constant term, transferring meromorphic structure.
accepted_units.context_note: Includes rapid-decay hypotheses and the completed-Eisenstein pole statement.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Strong display dependence; prose preserves the transformation and poles.

accepted_units.title: Reverse Mellin mapping makes zeros into horocycle error exponents
accepted_units.why_material: Maps transform singularities to small-height asymptotics and identifies nontrivial zeta zeros as deviations from horocycle equidistribution.
accepted_units.context_note: The limiting average is the fundamental-domain average.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Inverse-Mellin displays and exponent notation, with explicit prose interpretation.

accepted_units.title: Zagier subtraction extends the mechanism to moderate cusp growth
accepted_units.why_material: Subtracts power-log cusp behavior, yielding deterministic reflected terms plus zeta-zero corrections and the modular average.
accepted_units.context_note: Essential bridge to massless string partition functions; rapid growth remains excluded.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High display dependence for regularization, poles, and asymptotics.

accepted_units.title: Discriminant horocycle averages oscillate at zero frequencies
accepted_units.why_material: Instantiates the theorem with the modular discriminant and derives zero-indexed errors and the critical-line oscillatory form under RH.
accepted_units.context_note: Carried v1 span unchanged; repair context includes section framing and numerical confirmation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Product, series, and asymptotic displays need scan verification for exact constants.

accepted_units.title: Fourier analysis of the error recovers leading zero frequencies
accepted_units.why_material: Compares empirically extracted error frequencies with the first two nontrivial zeta zeros.
accepted_units.context_note: Rough numerical support, not independent proof.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Caption and prose-reported analysis; raw graph data are unavailable.

accepted_units.title: A theta example hides zero oscillations behind a power term
accepted_units.why_material: Poisson resummation gives monotone convergence while a square-root correction dominates the zero-dependent terms.
accepted_units.context_note: Contrasts with the visible discriminant oscillations.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Formula-dependent theta representation, average, and exponent comparison.

accepted_units.title: Orthogonality forces all zero residues to vanish in the theta example
accepted_units.why_material: Inverse-Mellin Eisenstein representation and spectral orthogonality make each coefficient proportional to a completed-zeta value at its zero.
accepted_units.context_note: Blocks the assumption that every automorphic observable shows nonzero RH oscillations.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Display-heavy orthogonality and residue calculation; prose states exact vanishing.

accepted_units.title: Tachyon conditions determine applicability to string partitions
accepted_units.why_material: Defines vacuum energy and signed states, distinguishes physical from unphysical tachyons, and explains why finite level-matched energy alone is insufficient.
accepted_units.context_note: Supplies the hypotheses and notation for the carried cutoff unit.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Partition and level-matching formulas carry OCR risk; prose makes the distinction explicit.

accepted_units.unit_type: cutoff asymptotic for graded physical states
accepted_units.title: Cutoff-weighted graded states converge with zeta-controlled error
accepted_units.why_material: Identifies proper time with inverse UV cutoff and derives the state-sum asymptotic whose minimal error exponent occurs under RH.
accepted_units.context_note: Carried v1 span unchanged; repair restores definitions, hypotheses, and following interpretation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High dependence on cutoff, mass, degeneracy, and asymptotic displays.

accepted_units.title: The asymptotic encodes misaligned supersymmetry and a vacuum estimator
accepted_units.why_material: Extracts asymptotic graded cancellation with zero-driven log oscillations and an inverse regulated finite-state approximation to vacuum energy.
accepted_units.context_note: Warns that the estimator requires delicate cancellation of large contributions.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Asymptotic and inverse displays plus schematic figure prose.

accepted_units.title: Differentiating the cutoff generator yields vanishing low supertraces
accepted_units.why_material: Uses the graded sum as a mass-supertrace generator and derives dimension-dependent vanishing below a threshold order.
accepted_units.context_note: Reusable consequence beyond vacuum energy and raw density.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Differentiation, Pochhammer, and exponent displays.

accepted_units.title: Finite temperature gives controlled breaking below a tachyon threshold
accepted_units.why_material: Shifted momenta, windings, and GSO phases break degeneracy while the Hagedorn threshold bounds perturbative validity.
accepted_units.context_note: Defines the partition underlying the carried temperature evaluation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Exact character/lattice partition is display-dependent; the regime is clear in prose.

accepted_units.title: Low-temperature energy has integral and regulated-state representations
accepted_units.why_material: Gives the unfolded energy, massless-state dominance through Bessel suppression, and the alternative graded-state approximation.
accepted_units.context_note: Carried v1 span unchanged; repair supplies the partition and post-formula interpretation.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Special-function constants and powers are OCR-sensitive; the dual representation is clear.

accepted_units.title: Exponential degeneracy makes the estimator a precision-cancellation problem
accepted_units.why_material: Hardy-Ramanujan growth forces a rapidly growing truncation and cancellation of huge bosonic and fermionic totals.
accepted_units.context_note: Contrasts fast discriminant convergence with string and lattice costs.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Coefficient and truncation-scale formulas support explicit prose.

accepted_units.title: A rational Scherk-Schwarz model realizes alternating coefficients
accepted_units.why_material: An asymmetric orbifold and theta representation expose the Fourier constant term and coefficient-by-coefficient alternation in a tachyon-free vacuum.
accepted_units.context_note: The modular integral supplies the later comparison target.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Very high character, convolution, and coefficient formula dependence.

accepted_units.title: The Scherk-Schwarz sum shows RH-consistent energy oscillations
accepted_units.why_material: Connects explicit alternating coefficients to the general zero-frequency error and reports convergence toward vacuum energy.
accepted_units.context_note: Model-specific truncated numerical consistency, not proof of RH.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Figure caption and asymptotic display; no raw plotted data.

accepted_units.title: Physical tachyons sever the simple rapid-growth UV-IR link
accepted_units.why_material: Explains the absence of a rapid-growth theorem and why divergent free energy may coexist with asymptotic graded cancellation.
accepted_units.context_note: Blocks naive inference from UV density to instability.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Primarily the physical/unphysical tachyon and growth-class distinctions.

accepted_units.title: A singular-plus-moderate split could recover a constant-term relation
accepted_units.why_material: Proposes isolating a rapid automorphic component with zero constant term so the remainder remains eligible for the theorem; j is the model.
accepted_units.context_note: Existence and naturalness of the split are explicitly unknown.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Decomposition, constant-term integral, and j expansion.

accepted_units.title: A j-subtraction isolates a moderate two-dimensional partition
accepted_units.why_material: Uses the unphysical tachyon to choose an antiholomorphic modular completion, subtracts it, and relates the remainder to a physical constant-term limit.
accepted_units.context_note: Nonholomorphic completion is nonunique; evidence for, not proof of, the conjecture.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: High character, theta, expansion, and completion dependence.

accepted_units.title: Slow convergence blocks a clean two-dimensional asymptotic test
accepted_units.why_material: Reports unreachable small-proper-time behavior while observing light-state dominance and small practical contribution from the singular completion.
accepted_units.context_note: Separates conceptual necessity from numerical dominance.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Prose-reported percentages and figure, without raw data.

accepted_units.title: The ten-dimensional extension has only low-accuracy numerical support
accepted_units.why_material: Shows why proper-time powers obstruct explicit completion, defines an unambiguous constant term, and proposes an RH-conditioned error tested numerically.
accepted_units.context_note: The authors call the accuracy poor and request further mathematical and numerical work.
accepted_units.representation_dependency: Very high formula/OCR dependence for expansion, subtraction, sum, and error exponent.
